intelephense.diagnostics.undefinedTypes.markdownDescription: Enables undefined class, interface and trait diagnostics.

intelephense.licenceKey.markdownDescription: DEPRECATED. Don't use this. Go to command palette and search for enter licence key.

intelephense.diagnostics.unusedSymbols.markdownDescription: Enables unused variable, private member, and import diagnostics.

intelephense.rename.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns matching files and folders that should be excluded when renaming symbols. Rename operation will fail if the symbol definition is found in the excluded files/folders.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Argument count diagnostics will be emitted for declared functions and methods and annotated `@method` methods.
Argument count diagnostics will be emitted for declared functions and methods only. Annotated `@method` methods will be ignored.
Argument count diagnostics will be disabled.

intelephense.references.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns matching files and folders that should be excluded from references search.

intelephense.phpdoc.returnVoid.markdownDescription: Adds `@return void` to auto generated phpdoc for definitions that do not return a value.

enumDescriptions: Auto generated phpdoc is returned in snippet format. Templates are partially resolved by evaluating phpdoc specific variables only.
Auto generated phpdoc is returned as plain text. Templates are resolved completely by the server.

intelephense.diagnostics.typeErrors.markdownDescription: Enables diagnostics on type compatibility of arguments, property assignments, and return statements where types have been declared.

intelephense.phpdoc.classTemplate.markdownDescription: An object that describes the format of generated class/interface/trait phpdoc. The following snippet variables are available: SYMBOL_NAME; SYMBOL_KIND; SYMBOL_TYPE; SYMBOL_NAMESPACE.

tags.markdownDescription: An array of snippet strings representing phpdoc tags.

summary.markdownDescription: A snippet string representing a phpdoc summary.

description.markdownDescription: A snippet string representing a phpdoc description.

intelephense.diagnostics.languageConstra.markdownDescription: Enables reporting of various language constraint errors.

intelephense.diagnostics.implementationE.markdownDescription: Enables reporting of problems associated with method and class implementations. For example, unimplemented methods or method signature incompatibilities.

intelephense.diagnostics.relaxedTypeChec.markdownDescription: This setting makes type checking less thorough by allowing contravariant (wider) types to also satisfy a type constraint. This is useful for projects that may have incomplete or innacurate typings. Set to `false` for more thorough type checks. When this setting is `true`, the `noMixedTypeCheck` setting is ignored.

intelephense.phpdoc.propertyTemplate.markdownDescription: An object that describes the format of generated property phpdoc. The following snippet variables are available: SYMBOL_NAME; SYMBOL_KIND; SYMBOL_TYPE; SYMBOL_NAMESPACE.

tags.markdownDescription: An array of snippet strings representing phpdoc tags.

summary.markdownDescription: A snippet string representing a phpdoc summary.

description.markdownDescription: A snippet string representing a phpdoc description.

intelephense.diagnostics.noMixedTypeChec.markdownDescription: This setting turns off type checking for the `mixed` type. This is useful for projects that may have incomplete or innacurate typings. Set to `false` to make type checking more thorough by not allowing `mixed` to satisy any type constraint. This setting has no effect when `relaxedTypeCheck` is `true`.

intelephense.phpdoc.functionTemplate.markdownDescription: An object that describes the format of generated function/method phpdoc. The following snippet variables are available: SYMBOL_NAME; SYMBOL_KIND; SYMBOL_TYPE; SYMBOL_NAMESPACE.

tags.markdownDescription: An array of snippet strings representing phpdoc tags.

summary.markdownDescription: A snippet string representing a phpdoc summary.

description.markdownDescription: A snippet string representing a phpdoc description.

intelephense.runtime.markdownDescription: Path to a Node.js executable. Use this if you wish to use a different version of Node.js. Defaults to Node.js shipped with VSCode.

intelephense.phpdoc.useFullyQualifiedNam.markdownDescription: Fully qualified names will be used for types when true. When false short type names will be used and imported where appropriate. Overrides intelephense.completion.insertUseDeclaration.

intelephense.diagnostics.strictTypes.markdownDescription: When enabled, type checks will be performed as if a `declare(strict_types=1)` directive is present in all files.

intelephense.trace.server.markdownDescription: Traces the communication between VSCode and the intelephense language server.

intelephense.diagnostics.suppressUndefin.markdownDescription: Suppresses undefined property and method errors when `__get` or `__call` magic methods are declared.

intelephense.codeLens.references.enable.markdownDescription: Enable a code lens that shows a reference count and command to peek locations.

enumDescriptions: Error.
Warning.
Information.
Hint.

intelephense.diagnostics.severity.markdownDescription: Sets the severity level for each diagnostic code.

intelephense.codeLens.implementations.en.markdownDescription: Enable a code lens that shows an abstract and interface implementations count and command to peek locations.

intelephense.codeLens.usages.enable.markdownDescription: Enable a code lens that shows a trait usages count and command to peek locations.

intelephense.codeLens.overrides.enable.markdownDescription: Enable a code lens that shows method override count and command to peek locations.

intelephense.compatibility.correctForArr.markdownDescription:
Resolves `ArrayAccess` and `Traversable` implementations that are unioned with a typed array to generic syntax.

For example: `ArrayAccessAndTraversable|Element[]` => `ArrayAccessAndTraversable&ArrayAccess<int, Element>&Traversable<int, Element>`.

intelephense.codeLens.parent.enable.markdownDescription: Enable a code lens that indicates if a method has a parent implementation and command to peek location.

intelephense.diagnostics.exclude.markdownDescription: A map of globs to diagnostic codes to be excluded for the matching files. Use `*` as a value in the array to exclude all diagnostics. By default the vendor directory is excluded. You can override this by setting `**/vendor/**` to an empty array.

intelephense.shortOpenEchoAutoClose.markdownDescription: Will auto-close short open echo tags (`<?=`). VSCode only.

intelephense.inlayHint.returnTypes.markdownDescription: Will show an inlay hint for call declaration return type if not already declared.

intelephense.files.associations.markdownDescription: Configure glob patterns to make files available for language server features. Inherits from files.associations.

intelephense.inlayHint.parameterTypes.markdownDescription: Will show inlay hints for anonymous function declaration parameter types if not already declared.

intelephense.completion.insertUseDeclara.markdownDescription: Use declarations will be automatically inserted for namespaced classes, traits, interfaces, functions, and constants.

intelephense.completion.fullyQualifyGlob.markdownDescription: Global namespace constants and functions will be fully qualified (prefixed with a backslash).

intelephense.completion.triggerParameter.markdownDescription: Method and function completions will include parentheses and trigger parameter hints.

intelephense.completion.maxItems.markdownDescription: The maximum number of completion items returned per request.

intelephense.completion.suggestObjectOpe.markdownDescription: PHP permits the calling of static methods using the object operator eg `$obj->myStaticMethod();`. If you would prefer not to have static methods suggested in this context then set this value to `false`. Defaults to `true`.

enumDescriptions: camelCase
snake_case
intelephense.completion.parameterCase.markdownDescription: The preferred font case to use when suggesting parameter names. Defaults to camel case.

intelephense.stubs.markdownDescription: Configure stub files for built in symbols and common extensions. The default setting includes PHP core and all bundled extensions.

enumDescriptions: camelCase
snake_case
intelephense.completion.propertyCase.markdownDescription: The preferred font case to use when suggesting property names. Defaults to snake case.

intelephense.completion.suggestRelativeT.markdownDescription: Inserted text will be relative to any existing partial use declarations that may match the symbol. The value is the maximum number of namespace segments that may appear in the inserted text. Defaults to 0 (disabled).

enumDescriptions: No `sortText` property will be provided. The client is solely responsible for sorting based on the `label` property.
A `sortText` property will be included based on factors like query match, kind of suggestion, location of symbol, name of symbol.
intelephense.completion.sortText.markdownDescription: Controls whether suggestions will include a `sortText` property that may influence sort order.

intelephense.completion.withOverrideAttr.markdownDescription: Method completions will include an `#[Override]` attribute where appropriate if targeting PHP 8.3+.

intelephense.completion.withMethodBody.markdownDescription: Method completions will include either a `parent` call or a `throw new Exception('Not implemented')` in the method body.

enumDescriptions: PHP-FIG PER-CS style. A mix of Allman and K&R. https://www.php-fig.org/per/coding-style/
Allman. Opening brace on the next line.
K&R (1TBS). Opening brace on the same line.

intelephense.environment.documentRoot.markdownDescription: The directory of the entry point to the application (directory of index.php). Can be absolute or relative to the workspace folder. Used for resolving script inclusion and path suggestions.

intelephense.environment.includePaths.markdownDescription: The include paths (as individual path items) as defined in the include_path ini setting or paths to external libraries. Can be absolute or relative to the workspace folder. Used for resolving script inclusion and/or adding external symbols to folder.

intelephense.environment.phpVersion.markdownDescription: A semver compatible string that represents the target PHP version. Used for providing version appropriate suggestions and diagnostics. PHP 5.3.0 and greater supported.

intelephense.environment.shortOpenTag.markdownDescription: When enabled '<?' will be parsed as a PHP open tag. Defaults to true.

enumDescriptions: Diagnostics will run as changes are made to the document.
Diagnostics will run when the document is saved.

intelephense.throwDepth.markdownDescription: The maximum call depth to follow when analyzing throw expressions. Defaults to `0`, which limits analysis to the current function. Higher values can have a negative impact on performance.

intelephense.inlayHint.parameterNames.markdownDescription: Will show inlay hints for call argument parameter names if named arguments are not already in use.

intelephense.files.exclude.markdownDescription: Configure glob patterns to exclude certain files and folders from all language server features. Inherits from files.exclude.

intelephense.maxMemory.markdownDescription: Maximum memory (in MB) that the server should use. On some systems this may only have effect when runtime has been set. Minimum 256.

intelephense.compatibility.preferPsalmPh.markdownDescription: Prefer `@psalm-` and `@phpstan-` prefixed `@return`, `@var`, `@param` tags when determining symbol types.

intelephense.diagnostics.suspectCode.markdownDescription: Enables reporting of irregularities in code that may be indicative of a bug. For example, assignments in a conditional expression or duplicate array keys.

intelephense.diagnostics.undefinedSymbol.markdownDescription: DEPRECATED. Use the setting for each symbol category.

intelephense.diagnostics.memberAccess.markdownDescription: Enables reporting of errors associated with type member access.

enumDescriptions: Undefined variable diagnostics will be emitted for global and local scope variables.
Undefined variable diagnostics will be emitted for local scope variables only.
Undefined variable diagnostics will be disabled.

intelephense.telemetry.enabled.markdownDescription: When set to `true`, anonymous usage and crash data will be sent to Azure Application Insights. Defaults to `false`.

enumDescriptions: Only symbols defined in the current file are affected. For example, this makes a rename of a namespace the equivalent of a single move class operation.
All symbols that share this namespace, not necessarily defined in the current file will be affected. For example it would move all classes that share this namespace to the new namespace.
intelephense.rename.namespaceMode.markdownDescription: Controls the scope of a namespace rename operation.
